I'm really excited to bring you lots of great music tonight, thanks to 704 West High Street, who were on air before this. Utility Fog is broadcast on FBI radio, Which itself is on the lands of the Gadigal of the Eora Nation This is unceded land and I pay my respects to elders past, present and emerging I started with AFA, the work of Becky Witton from Naam or based in Naam for years now It's been a while since a new album of songs, of pop songs at least and beats and things from AFA She's been doing her sort of live choral looping and voice processing for a while Which is lovely, lovely stuff But great to hear some new songs We started The Can't Be Killed from her new album Avarina Which is finally out now I actually heard this album practically 12 months ago But things take a while in the music industry This is out through the Great Birds Road Robe, not Road, Records, based here in Eora, Sydney. We're going to hear another one now with another singer that Becky has been working with on production and mixing and mastering duties as she does with lots of people, featuring Ja Lafine. So the two musicians were kind of known to each other and it's lovely that they have now worked together.
